# Period Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PeriodType`](gmeow-PeriodType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PeriodType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a named period (geologic eon, era, period, epoch, age; historical dynasty, era; fiscal year). A value, never a subclass.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PeriodType`](gmeow-PeriodType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for classifying a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) by its defining domain — geologic rank, historical kind, fiscal kind — referenced through [`gmeow:periodType`](../properties/gmeow-periodType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling a period kind as a subclass of [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) (kinds are individuals) and avoid using it for the period's bounds; the type names the category, not the extent.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:PeriodType`](gmeow-PeriodType.md) individual from a period via [`gmeow:periodType`](../properties/gmeow-periodType.md); align it to an external authority (ICS geologic ranks) with [skos:exactMatch](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#exactMatch) in the mapping DSL, and mint new individuals rather than subclasses.

### Examples

- ex:myType a [`gmeow:PeriodType`](gmeow-PeriodType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "artistic movement"@en.
